crossRefs.note: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?
that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, That they are led out to the day of wrath?
Yahweh examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.
“There is no peace”, says my God, “for the wicked.”
Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t…
So will it be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,
and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be the weeping and the gnashing of teeth.”
and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the…
But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half…
therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes…
In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their…
For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can…
My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.
Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.
He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.
Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.”
Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.
Whereas you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears…

translations.web: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he lengthen days like a shadow, because he doesn’t fear God.
translations.bsb: Yet because the wicked do not fear God, it will not go well with them, and their days will not lengthen like a shadow.
translations.kjv: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.
translations.asv: but it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong his days, which are as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.
